Discover what Doha has to offer with famous attractions such as the historic Lusail Stadium, Souq Waqif, Katara Cultural Village, Corniche, The Pearl, Westbay, Lagoona Mall and Place Vendome Mall with just a 10–15-minute drive away.

d: Reload Logistics is a young and dynamic company that has experienced fast growth and recognized as a lead player amongst Freight Forwarders in Southern Africa. As a Transport Controller at Reload Logistics, you are responsible for end-to-end coordination of cargo movements, including document preparation, ETA monitoring, capacity allocation, and daily client reporting.

The role involves managing client and supplier communication, handling incidents, coordinating ground operations, and supporting compliance through SOPs. Additionally, you will lead a small team and provide critical feedback to Key Account Managers to ensure service excellence and operational efficiency.
q: Experience: Minimum of 5-6 years in logistics, freight forwarding, or transport operations with direct responsibility for job control, client coordination, and operational execution.
Documentation Expertise: Strong understanding of transport documentation, including packing lists, road manifests, client invoices, and customs clearance documents.
Client & Supplier Coordination: Proven experience in managing client relationships, handling exceptions and queries, and maintaining communication with suppliers regarding bookings and delays.
Monitoring & Reporting: Ability to monitor ETAs, capacity execution, and demurrage, while ensuring timely, accurate client reporting in prescribed formats.
Incident & Risk Management: Knowledge of incident reporting and risk event handling (accidents, breakdowns, unauthorized stops, etc.), with the ability to implement timely resolutions.
Team Leadership: Experience in managing small operational teams (3–4 people), including providing guidance, training, and performance feedback.
Systems & Tools Proficiency: Comfortable working with logistics systems, spreadsheets, and reporting tools to monitor transit times, warehouse dwell times, and overall operational KPIs.
Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills for clear client updates, team coordination, SOP creation, and escalation management.
Process Management: Demonstrated ability to create and implement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and support continuous improvement in transport operations.
Analytical Ability: Capable of generating and analyzing month-end reports, identifying performance trends, and recommending operational improvements.
Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy in documentation, client feedback, and exception handling.
r: Preparing job details (dates, documentation, clearing agent, loading/offloading points, distribution lists).

Managing supplier communication and feedback (regarding new bookings and delays).
Handling incident management and risk events (accidents, breakdowns, unauthorized stops, etc.).
Managing escort arrangements (confirming high-value cargo details).
Coordinating with ground teams at loading, offloading, and border points.
Participating in three weekly meetings to address issues, seek clarifications, discuss the way forward, and manage escalations.
Creating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as needed.
Directly managing a team of 2-4 individuals, including Operations Expeditor and Purchase Expeditor.
Providing ongoing feedback to Key Account Managers regarding client status.
